newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Amsteel unit FRN raised to US$100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Amsteel unit FRN raised to US$100 mln.

text.p: Amsteel Capital International BV's three-year floating rate note issue has been increased to US$100 million from US$50 million due to oversubscription, bankers said on Friday.
The issue is guaranteed by Amsteel Capital Holdings, which is wholly owned by Amsteel Corp.
The notes were priced at par to float at 135 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 140 basis points.
Arrangers are Peregrine Capital and Overseas Union Bank.
Twenty-four institutions in addition to the arrangers joined the syndication.
